cases.label: buggy
findings: [major/correctness] app/util/collect.py:1 — Mutable default argument `bucket=[]` is a classic Python pitfall. The same list object is reused across all function calls, causing unexpected state sharing between invocations. Use `bucket=None` and initialize to `[]` inside the function instead.

cases.label: buggy
findings: [critical/correctness] app/utils/pagination.py:4 — Incorrect slice indexing: `items[i * page_size]` accesses a single element at position `i * page_size`, not a page of items. Should use `items[i * page_size:(i + 1) * page_size]` to get a slice of `page_size` items.

[major/correctness] app/utils/pagination.py:1 — The function name `last_page_items` suggests returning only the last page, but the implementation attempts to return all pages. The function logic and name are misaligned.
